name: Panorama Residence Mösern
beschreibung: Panorama Residence Mösern is a holiday apartment complex in the municipality of Telfs above the Mösern district. It stands out thanks to its exposed location on the Sonnenplateau, which offers a comprehensive view of the Inntal. The surroundings are characterized by forests and alpine pastures, making relaxation in nature possible. The apartments are equipped with fully equipped kitchens, bathrooms, and balconies. The complex includes a shared wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The quiet atmosphere is aimed especially at couples and families looking for a relaxing holiday. Culinary offerings in the immediate vicinity include several traditional inns and the Alpine inns on the Sonnenplateau.
